Alan Painter and Dave Mole were new Vets this track season and both set club records. Alan ran 1.59.9 for 800m on his 40th Birthday, reducing that time to 1.59.1 in a Rosenheim League match.

Derek Clack and Alan Painter finished within 15 seconds of each other at the Vet's AC race on January 25th, 28:24 to 28:39, but two weeks later Derek took almost a whole minute off his time and shot up to 7th with 27:28.
